# Data Analyst Salary   [2026 Guide]
## Average Data Analyst Salary in Australia
**The average salary for a data analyst in Australia as of June 2026 is $105,000 per annum, according to Seek.**

RealPay places the average data analyst salary at a more conservative $91,438 per annum, calculated across major cities like Sydney, Canberra, and Melbourne.

Glassdoor’s average data analyst salary of $105,700 lines up more closely with the Seek data, placing the earnings range at $84,500 for the 25th percentile, $122,000 for the 75th percentile, and up to $150,000 for top earners.

### Average Data Analyst Salary by Years of Experience
| Level | Experience | Typical Salary Base (2026) |
|-|-|-|
| Entry-level / graduate | <1-4 year | $68,000 – $85,000 |
| Mid-level | 3-5 years | $95,000 – $110,000 |
| Senior-level | 5-8+ years | $120,000 – $150,000 |

PayScale reports that data analysts typically earn annual bonuses ranging from $2,000 to $10,000 per annum.
